root_cause.text: The L2TP transmit function `l2tp_xmit_core` lacks a check for whether the computed UDP datagram length exceeds the 16-bit UDP length field maximum (65535), causing silent truncation of the length value when assigning `uh->len`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "the actual issue is an overflow of 16-bit UDP length field" and "l2tp_xmit_core doesn't check for overflows when it assigns the UDP length field. The value gets trimmed to 16 bites." The fix adds `if (udp_len > U16_MAX) { kfree_skb(skb); ... }` to drop oversized packets, and the syzbot repro sends a 0x34000-byte packet that triggers the overflow.
